title: Stripe payments
summary: Registers a PaymentGateway into the kernel payment-method shell. Card, PayPal, Bancontact, Google Pay, Apple Pay.

blocks.title: Do not edit the payment-method shell
blocks.text: api.registerPaymentGateway. Checkout lists methods only while this plugin is on. Saved cards and webhooks live in this package.
Env secrets stay in this plugin's Stripe client. Kernel checkout never names Stripe in extraLines.

Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-payment-stripe/ (public config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: string — public. pk_test_… or pk_live_… from the Stripe Dashboard. Safe to show in the browser; required for Checkout.
secret — secret. sk_test_… or sk_live_…. The kernel charges with this key. Type a new value only to replace it.
secret — secret. whsec_… from the Stripe webhook endpoint. Required so payment events are verified. Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
string — public. How long a Stripe API call may wait (for example 12s) before checkout fails the attempt.
string — public. How early staff get a spy mail before an uncaptured payment authorization expires (for example 2d).
number — public. Days to keep a card used once, then drop it. Raise only if you need longer replay for failed captures.
